desc: 粗链身金属浮雕坠、冷银暗调切面、街头通勤佩戴款
leaf: 男士钛钢朋克粗链吊坠项链
name: 钛钢朋克古巴链吊坠项链款

shots.intent: 以暗底光盒的金属切面与厚重链身抓眼球，一秒传达「有分量、切面清楚、光泽受控」的第一印象。
用三栏并置的失败体验（闷痒泛红、链型陈旧、边缘刮肤）放大犹豫，让买家先认同问题再看方案。
shots.textZone: 顶部居中标题区占画高 12%，三栏下方各一个短标签位，文字为 {callout_1} {callout_2} {callout_3}

shots.intent: 同框同光双栏呈现普通版本与本款在链身厚度、浮雕高度与反光上的可观察差距，让证据代替口号。
shots.textZone: 顶部一个短标题位 {selling_point_1}，两栏上方各一个 13pt 标签位 {callout_1} {callout_2}

shots.intent: 用微距把浮雕层次、倒角和抛光面证据化，替买家回答「实物够不够精细」。
侧面 90° 交代链环厚度、坠扣与连接工艺，把「链子够不够粗、扣会不会松」一次讲清。
用无脸的颈下取景给出真实佩戴长度与风格参照，让目标买家直接代入自己。
浅色石面与深色金属的强反差做氛围种草，撑起社媒首图与街头风格调性。
用尺寸线与键值栏把链长与坠体尺寸讲清楚，消灭「戴上多长、坠子多大」的下单阻力。
shots.textZone: 左侧 32% 为规格键值栏，链身与坠体上方各一条尺寸线，数值占位 {dimension_1} {dimension_2} {dimension_3}

shots.intent: 用可执行的佩戴与保养要点承接参数区，替买家降低「日常好不好打理」的售后顾虑。
shots.textZone: 顶部标题位 {selling_point_1}，三栏各一个 13pt 标签位 {callout_1} {callout_2} {callout_3}

shots.intent: 把可选金属色排成整齐矩阵，让买家自助完成选款并提高连带件数。
以开箱收纳场景收口，把「到手有盒子、送礼体面、日常好存放」作为最后的风险消除。

style.backgroundSystem: light-controlled dark jewelry box: deep charcoal seamless and black velvet fields carry the metal shots, one pale concrete/stone field for the styling shots, warm off-white for the spec and info screens; every surface is a real light-controlled material, never a random gradient
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons and hairline leader lines, max 4 marks per screen, no filled badges, no certification seals
style.lightingSystem: jewelry lightbox tent with one narrow specular strip key from upper-left plus a bounce card on the shadow side, deep pool reflections on polished faces, crisp specular dots on bevel edges and chain links, controlled falloff, no blown highlights and no sparkle flares
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium dark-tone street jewelry ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep charcoal #141416, warm pale concrete #C6C3BD, warm off-white #F4F1EA and one cool silver highlight accent #BFC4C8; cool neutral tone; jewelry lightbox tent lighting, one narrow specular strip key from upper-left plus a bounce card on the shadow side, deep pool reflections on polished metal, crisp specular dots on bevel edges, controlled falloff, no blown highlights; modern geometric sans-serif with thin hairline keyline label boxes; consistent thin single-weight line icon style; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal label-led infographic elements; stable metal color, stable chain link proportions and stable product scale and placement; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no blown-out highlights or added sparkle, no mismatched icon styles, no brand marks or QR codes.
noDrift: no warm-golden cast on the metal
no blown-out specular highlights or added sparkle flares
no brand marks, store badges or QR codes
style.presentationRules: metal tone and surface finish stay identical across all shots; hero pendant angle stays consistent; the full chain silhouette appears only on the flat-lay and spec screens while the rest stay mid or close crops; pendant always grounded by its own contact shadow or by the material it rests on
style.surfaceSystem: black velvet tray, matte carbon-slate panel, dark grained wood plank, pale concrete stone, unbranded blank keepsake box
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, thin hairline keyline label boxes and one short rule, sparse label-led infographic overlays, light copy on dark fields and dark copy on light fields
